concept: Review and integration: a personal code of honor built from professional, relational, and civic practice
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across professional integrity, hard conversations, and civic commitment — what's the throughline in how you want to operate?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what honor means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement that references at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
